reason: This plugin is primarily a local image-serving utility for chat, exposing a web preview endpoint and a tool that converts existing local image paths into inline-renderable URLs so users/agents can display pictures in conversation. The evidence shows it is focused on media preview workflow (preview directory, `/preview/*`, and `preview_image`) rather than general file management, workflow orchestration, search, or project analysis.

summaries.zh: 这是一个本地图片预览插件，在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 会话中通过本地 HTTP 地址提供图片托管，并提供 `preview_image` 工具将本地图片放入预览目录后返回可内嵌显示的链接。
summaries.en: This plugin enables local image preview in DeepSeek Harness web chats by serving files from a local directory through an HTTP preview route and exposing a `preview_image` tool that returns an inline-capable URL for existing local images.

capabilities: Serves image files through a local web route under `/preview/*`
Provides a `preview_image(file_path)` model tool that stages existing local images and returns a URL
Supports configurable preview directory and URL prefix via plugin config
Applies image extension checks and path validation for served/staged files
Serves image files through a local web route under `/preview/*`

Supports configurable preview directory and URL prefix via plugin config
Applies image extension checks and path validation for served/staged files
